' AND A.AC_GR in( '19','22','23') ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

' AND C.AC_GR in( '19','22','23') AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ?
